binding_clause_coverage.canonical_predecessor_semantics: For a conjunctive hard-plus-regression relation, the binding clause is the tighter canonical predecessor boundary. The other clause is logically dominated for this exact frozen baseline. The continuous guard has different straight and curve thresholds, so both branches are independently witnessed.

metric_definitions.acceleration_p95_m_s2: P95 norm of source-aligned world acceleration during the motion window.
metric_definitions.angular_rate_p95_rad_s: P95 norm of body angular velocity from source-aligned IMU samples.
metric_definitions.checkpoint_hold_conformance_fraction: Fraction of authored CHECKPOINT nodes captured inside their ball and held for authored dwell within plus or minus 0.02 source seconds.
metric_definitions.collision_count: Count of independently recomputed vehicle-envelope intersections with world solids.
metric_definitions.duration_s: Source-clock elapsed time from accepted takeoff motion start through terminal motor cutoff.
metric_definitions.electrical_energy_used_j: Trapezoidal source-time integral of measured battery voltage times current from accepted motion start through motor cutoff.
metric_definitions.jerk_p95_m_s3: P95 finite-difference acceleration derivative on unique source-sequence samples.
metric_definitions.minimum_clearance_m: Minimum independent geometry distance from observed vehicle envelope to perceived solid over the executed path.
metric_definitions.minimum_continuous_knot_speed_ratio: Minimum observed-to-adjacent-target speed ratio at authored CONTINUOUS_FLY_THROUGH nodes; straight ordinary knots use 0.85 and the curve repeated crossover uses 0.95.
metric_definitions.minimum_motor_thrust_headroom_n: Minimum over all motion samples and motors of configured maximum thrust minus applied thrust, in newtons.
metric_definitions.motor_differential_normalized_error_p95: P95 absolute measured-minus-expected signed motor-pair differential divided by max(expected absolute differential, 0.005 N).
metric_definitions.motor_differential_sign_agreement_fracti: Fraction of samples with an independently expected nonzero X-layout torque whose measured signed motor-pair differential has the expected sign.
metric_definitions.motor_saturation_fraction: Fraction of motion-window samples with any motor saturation flag set.
metric_definitions.motor_spread_p95_percent: P95 per-sample maximum minus minimum applied motor PWM percentage.
metric_definitions.path_tube_max_error_m: Maximum observed-position distance outside the planned path centreline during the motion window.
metric_definitions.speed_compliance_fraction: Fraction of unique source-sequence cruise samples inside the active target-speed band.
metric_definitions.speed_ripple_m_s: Cruise source-sequence speed p95 minus p05 in metres per second.
metric_definitions.supervisor_safety_gate_passed: Literal conjunction of the retained Safety Supervisor decisions for the whole session.
metric_definitions.terminal_reversal_count: Count of unintended velocity-component sign reversals in the literal terminal approach.
metric_definitions.terminal_secondary_peak_m_s: Largest literal last-approach secondary scalar-speed peak prominence.
metric_definitions.tracking_rms_m: RMS observed-position distance to the hash-bound planned trajectory at matched source time.
metric_definitions.unintended_fly_through_stop_count: Count of undeclared stops at CONTINUOUS_FLY_THROUGH nodes using the frozen stop-speed and dwell oracle.
